app.name: Granary
app.tagline: A desktop client compatible with Silo media servers.

addServer.title: Add a server
addServer.label: Server address
addServer.hint: The address you use for the Silo web app. Without a scheme, https:// is assumed.
addServer.known: This server is already saved; adding it again updates its address.
addServer.warnInsecure: This address uses plain http. Your password and everything you watch travel unencrypted. Use https if the server offers it.
addServer.warnUntested: Granary has not been tested with this server version. Most things should work; report anything that does not.
addServer.warnOrigin: The server reports that it was reached as {{origin}}. If that is unexpected, a proxy or redirect sits in between.

login.title: Sign in to {{server}}
login.passwordChange: This account has a temporary password. Change it in the Silo web app, then sign in here again.
login.revoked: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.empty: No libraries are visible to this profile.

browse.emptyHome: Nothing here yet. Your server's home rows appear once its libraries have content.

item.noVersions: This item has no playable file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: True black turns the background fully off on OLED screens.
settings.serversHint: Add, sign in to or remove servers.
settings.hwdecHint: Decode video on the GPU. Turn off only to troubleshoot.
settings.autoHdrHint: Turns Windows HDR on for HDR videos when it is off, and restores it afterwards.
settings.matchRefreshHint: Switches the display to the video's frame rate during playback (not needed with VRR). Always restored.
settings.passthroughHint: Send Dolby/DTS audio unchanged to an AV receiver.
settings.exclusiveHint: Takes over the audio device during playback (WASAPI exclusive).
settings.preferSdh: Prefer subtitles for the hard of hearing
settings.about: Granary is an independent desktop client, compatible with Silo media servers.

errors.invalid_url: That is not a valid server address.
errors.tls_not_yet_valid: The server's certificate is not valid yet. Check the date and time of this PC.
errors.tls_untrusted: The server's certificate is not trusted by Windows. If it uses your own certificate authority, install that authority in Windows first.
errors.tls_name_mismatch: The server's certificate does not match this address.
errors.tls_revoked: The server's certificate has been revoked.
errors.tls_error: A secure connection to the server could not be established.
errors.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your network.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.redirected: The server redirects to another address. Enter the final address instead.
errors.not_silo: No Silo server (API v2) answers at this address.
errors.unsupported_api: This server speaks an API version Granary does not support.
errors.account_required: The sign-in provider accepted you, but the server has no account for you. Ask an administrator.
errors.password_change_required: This account must change its password first. Use the Silo web app.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.client_upgrade_required: The server requires a newer Granary.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.unknown_server: This server is no longer saved.
errors.decode: The server sent a response Granary does not understand.
errors.credentials: Windows Credential Manager could not be used.
errors.invalid_request: Granary sent an invalid request. Please try again.
